jobs.title: FunCrafters
jobs.description: Fun Crafters - YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE AWAITS… A hub of gaming experts led by industry veterans. YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE AWAITS… CRAFTING THE NEXT AAA MOBILE HIT At FunCrafters we're shaping the future of mobile entertainment. Our elite team of industry veterans brings a wealth of experience from top-tier studios that contributed to the top 100 mobile games. Now, we're channeling our passion and expertise into creating a next generation Mid-Core RPG, based on one the world’s leading IP, and we’re going to redefine the genre. Our Values ORIGINALITY We believe in fresh perspectives. Our games are crafted with originality at their core. DEDICATION Every detail matters to us. We're dedicated to providing players with memorable experiences. PIONEERING We aren't just followers; we're trailblazers. We push boundaries for our players’ enjoyment. Team Aviram Steinhart CEO, founder A gaming visionary and former Plarium CEO, leading gaming innovation. Haim Turpiashvili CPO, founder Product leader who continues his gaming legacy through product development, former Co-founder and CPO of Plarium. Marek Wylon COO, founder A gaming operations leader with two decades of industry experience. Valentin Abalmasov Head of Technology Tech visionary, former Plarium CTO with a wealth of experience. Ruslan Iarmilko Head of Art Brings together the vision of art, animation and tech art. Ex-Plarium. Dmytro Prolygin Unity Engineering Lead Seasoned veteran with 15 years of game development experience and 20 years of software development in general. Ex-Ubisoft, ex-Scopely. Ziv Kitaro Creative Director Oversees the IP integration and narrative design. Ex-Plarium. Paweł Dzikowski Lead Game Designer Product Design: a gaming prodigy blending psychology and design. Mateusz Woś DESIGN PRODUCER Shaping gaming experiences, a gaming maven with a versatile career. Herman Bohdanov Economy, balance and LiveOps Designer Senior economy, balance and LiveOps designer, former Principal Game Designer of Plarium. Adrian Iliescu Tech Producer Tech Producer with expertise in AAA game production and technical management, bringing 12+ years of experience. Ex-Ubisoft. Artem Gansior ART DIRECTOR Guiding the artistic direction of our games. Previously at Plarium. Slava Lisovskyi Head of Animations and Cinematic Leads the game animation and motion design. Ex-Plarium. Anton Smolyarov Lead UI/UX Experienced leader of 2D Art, UI, and UX teams with many years of expertise at Plarium. Marina Kartashyan Art Producer Orchestrating our art production, never-before-seen quality on mobile. Ex-Playrix. Karolina Wąsala Head of HR Our seasoned gaming HR expert ensures Fun Crafters has the talent for success. Kacper Mendakiewicz Backend Tech Producer Backend and tools producer with many years of experience in game development. Natalia Gołębiowska Backend Engineering Lead Responsible for the backend systems that power our game's core services. Piotr Tomaszewski DevOps / Infrastructure From building data centers for AWS in eu-central and eu-north, through low-latency trading and FinOps, to Fun Crafters - where speed, reliability, and resource management are just as crucial. JOIN US! Join our journey to reshape the mobile RPG landscape. Dive into a world of captivating narratives and evolving quests. At FunCrafters, we believe in empowering our team. Become a key piece in our mosaic of talent.
